contract_title: Sovereign Energy Partners - Revolving Credit Facility

clauses.title: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
clauses.original_text: The Borrower shall ensure that the Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the final day of each fiscal month shall not be less than 1.25 to 1.00.

clauses.title: Maximum Permitted Senior Debt
clauses.original_text: Consolidated Senior Indebtedness shall at no time exceed 2.75 times trailing twelve months Consolidated EBITDA.

invariants.name: Senior Indebtedness Bound
invariants.description: Senior Debt cannot exceed 2.75 times EBITDA.
